title: 第七章 蓬莱拜山第八章 对战蓬莱首徒
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
秦天来到安妙菱的房间，直接推门而入。
“妙菱，师傅做了一顿好吃的，快来吃夜宵。”
话刚说完他就愣住了，因为此时安妙菱正在洗澡。
如玉般的双肩白腻如雪，在加上嫣红的小脸格外迷人。
最主要的是那完美比例的娇躯。
一瞬间他感觉鼻腔有点发热。
“师傅，你又不敲门就进来了。”安妙菱埋怨道。
“师傅这不是急着喊你吃饭，快穿衣服吧。”
“为师做了一大桌子好吃的，今天我们师徒喝一点。”
“出去。”
秦天退后几步站在门口。
“门关上。”安妙菱说道。
“为师不会偷看的，快点吧，等会饭菜都凉了。”
“我信你个鬼！”
说完安妙菱伸出玉手一挥，门就关上了。
秦天幽幽叹了一口气，“人与人之间的任性呢？”
门关上后，安妙菱就开始穿衣服。
穿哪件好呢！
选着选着，她看到了前不久秦天送给她的一件红色亵衣。
于是她穿上了，照镜子一看，胳膊和大腿都露出来了。

哼！
我就知道师傅是个涩人，不能便宜了他。
说完她又找了一块大的丝巾披上，把肩膀遮住了，大腿也遮住了一半。
穿上衣服后她就走到了餐厅，闻着菜香，一下食欲就上来了。
秦天也不是每天都做饭的，完全是看心情，或者是她特别要求。
不然的话有时一个月才做一顿饭。
有一段时间没吃了，所以她还是比较馋的。
等安妙菱吃了几口后，秦天就拿出一壶猴儿酿，把两个杯子满上。
“这东西，猕猴妖皇藏得太隐秘了，我好不容易才找到一壶。”
安妙菱笑了笑道，“这妖皇碰上你也是倒霉。”
“这种猴儿酿，除了需要五千年以上的灵果外，还需要猕猴一族，长达十年的酿制。”
“为师可不是为了自己去取的，是为了让你早日突破才去的取的。”
听到秦天这样一说，安妙菱还有点小感动了。
content_en:
Qin Tian came to An Miaoling's room and opened the door directly.
"Miao Ling, the master has made a delicious meal. Come and have a supper."
He was stunned as soon as he finished speaking, because An Miaoling was taking a shower at this time.
Her jade-like shoulders are as white as snow, and her bright red face is particularly charming.
The most important thing is that perfectly proportioned body.
For a moment, he felt a little warm in his nasal cavity.
"Master, you came in without knocking." An Miaoling complained.
"Master is not in a hurry to call you to eat. Please get dressed quickly."
"I made a big table of delicious food for my master. Today we, master and disciple, will have some."
"Get out."
Qin Tian took a few steps back and stood at the door.
"Close the door." An Miaoling said.
"Master will not peek. Come on, the food will be cold later."
"I believe you ghost!"
After saying that, An Miaoling stretched out her jade hand and waved, and the door was closed.
Qin Tian sighed quietly, "What about the willfulness between people?"
After the door closed, An Miaoling started to get dressed.
Which one should I wear?
As she was choosing, she saw a red garment that Qin Tian had given her not long ago.
So she put it on and looked in the mirror. Her arms and thighs were exposed.
snort!
I knew that the master was a shy person and I couldn't take advantage of him.
After saying that, she found a large silk scarf and put it on, covering her shoulders and half of her thighs.
After putting on her clothes, she walked to the restaurant, smelling the aroma of the dishes, and her appetite came up.
Qin Tian doesn't cook every day, it all depends on his mood or her special request.
Otherwise, sometimes I only cook one meal a month.
She hadn't eaten for a while, so she was still quite greedy.
After An Miaoling took a few bites, Qin Tian took out a pot of Hou'er brew and filled two cups.
"The Macaque Demon King hid this thing so secretly that I finally found a pot."
An Miaoling smiled and said, "This Demon King is also unlucky to meet you."
"This kind of monkey brew requires not only more than five thousand years of spiritual fruit, but also requires ten years of brewing by the macaque clan."
"Being a teacher is not something you take for yourself, it's something you take so that you can break through as soon as possible."
Hearing what Qin Tian said, An Miaoling was a little moved.
